title: CIBA Flow — Client Initiated Backchannel Authentication (agent + Keycloak)

steps.label: POST /agent/request
steps.detail: User invokes agent: 'Read my calendar'. Agent calls client with {userId, action: calendar_list, scope: calendar.read}.

steps.label: CIBA auth_request (poll mode)
steps.detail:
POST /realms/ciba-realm/protocol/openid-connect/ext/ciba/auth/authreq
client_id=ciba-agent
client_secret=***
login_hint=testuser
scope=openid profile calendar.read
binding_message=Read+your+calendar

steps.label: requestId (PENDING)
steps.detail: Client returns requestId with status=PENDING. Agent stores it in state machine (ConcurrentHashMap → Redis in P2).

steps.label: Push notification
steps.detail: Keycloak sends push to user's authenticator app: 'AI agent requests calendar.read'.

steps.label: User approves
steps.detail: User taps 'Approve' (or denies). In ping mode, Keycloak calls client's /ciba/ping-callback.

steps.label: Token request (poll mode)
steps.detail:
POST /realms/ciba-realm/protocol/openid-connect/ext/ciba/auth/token
grant_type=urn:openid:params:grant-type:ciba
auth_req_id=eyJ...
Every 5s until APPROVED or timeout.

steps.label: access_token (CTI + auth_req_id)
steps.detail: Response: { access_token, cti: "abc123", auth_req_id, scope: "calendar.read", expires_in: 300 }

steps.label: POST /agent/execute/{rid}
steps.detail: Agent asks client to execute the action with the now-approved token.

steps.label: GET /api/calendar/events
steps.detail:
Resource Server validates JWT:
- Signature (JWKS from Keycloak)
- aud = spring-boot-api
- cti NOT in replay cache (Caffeine 24h TTL, 10k entries)
- scope contains calendar.read

steps.label: Calendar events
steps.detail:
Response: 200 OK with [ { id, title, start, end }, ... ]
CTI recorded in cache — replay returns 401 cti_replay.

steps.label: success: true (data)
steps.detail: Client returns to agent the calendar data. Agent presents to user.
